regions.full_page: To know God - the rational creature's primary purpose - is to love Him. To serve God is to reign with Him. !!! Thy Excellency? Thy Purpose? 0! Ratonal Creature? Answer. God made me to know Him. 0! What a bles'd aim! To love Him and serve Him Sure rests in the same. Its Heaven begun - for The grateful - on earth. To treasure aright !!! Highest Heaven its Worth. (Ah! God Himself the final Prize.)
